Zhang, and Sanglu Lu. 2021. Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers

Interactive, Mobile, Wearable and Ubiquitous Technologies, Vol. 5. 1–25.
paper_level_summary_zh: 本文在相关工作部分引用了目标论文作为RFID振动感知的代表工作，但未详细描述其亚毫米级能力，仅提及RFID用于振动感知。

evidences.evidence_quote: On the other hand, some works use RF signals, such as Wi-Fi [48], mmWave [3,16,22,23,43,44,51,59], and RFID [7,30,46], to capture surrounding object vibration for sensing speaker-produced sound [3,22,23,30,44–46,48] or capture body motions for sensing human-speaking sound [7,16,43,51].
